category: Application Library examples: Molecular Flow Module
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the Molecular Flow Module. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Adsorption and Desorption of Water in a Load Lock Vacuum System [Molecular Flow Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Molecular Flow Module (Industrial Applications): Adsorption and Desorption of Water in a Load Lock Vacuum System. Physics interfaces: Free Molecular Flow (fmf). Study steps: Time Dependent. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("Molecular_Flow_Module/Industrial_Applications/water_adsorption_desorption") to solve it, comsol_example_info("water_adsorption_desorption", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > Molecular Flow Module > Industrial Applications > water adsorption desorption

parameters.name: fmf
parameters.description: physics interface Free Molecular Flow (API type FreeMolecularFlow)

tools.notes: Library path Molecular_Flow_Module/Industrial_Applications/water_adsorption_desorption; model file 1.6 MB. Documented Java build script available (rebuild with comsol_run_example method='java'). Requires the module licence to open and solve.
